description: This file defines Express.js routes for analytics endpoints in a backend service, including endpoints for LLM cost by agent, costs over time, and new user over time, with associated middleware for authentication and tenant verification.

methods.name: head /llm-cost-by-agent
methods.description: Health check endpoint for LLM cost by agent.

methods.name: options /llm-cost-by-agent
methods.description: Preflight OPTIONS request handler for the endpoint.

methods.name: GET /llm-cost-by-agent
methods.description: Retrieves LLM cost by agent, protected by authentication and tenant verification.

methods.name: GET /llm-costs/over-time
methods.description: Retrieves LLM costs over time for analytics visualization.

methods.name: GET /users/new-over-time
methods.description: Retrieves data on new users over time for analytics purposes.
